parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own SIGNL4 destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-signl4` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `signl4://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available. The free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`secret_secret`). The `gateway` / `gateway-plus` transformer channels instead POST a native SIGNL4 alert payload directly to your team webhook endpoint, bypassing Apprise: `gateway` is free (direct to your SIGNL4 team webhook, no Apprise), and `gateway-plus` is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment SIGNL4 destinations, direct.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SIGNL4 destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your SIGNL4 team webhook (no Apprise)

secret_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SIGNL4 team secret token
